privateDeals.what: Berkshire bought ~2.67M more Lennar Class A (and ~75K Class B) shares Sept 17-21, 2026 at ~$76-79; Class A holding now 23,719,109 shares (Form 3 filed as >10% owner)

Buffett converted 8,000 A shares to 12M B shares and gave 9M B to Susan Thompson Buffett Foundation and 1M each to Sherwood, Howard G. Buffett and NoVo foundations
Berkshire completed $8.5B EV acquisition of Taylor Morrison ($72.50/sh cash)
Berkshire completed $9.7B acquisition of OxyChem from Occidental
Berkshire sold DaVita shares back (1.66M in Jan, 1.22M in May, 183K in July 2026); held 28,697,229 DVA after 2026-07-31
Berkshire sold ~330K Liberty Live Series C shares in Jan 2026 (10.59M Series C, 4.99M Series A remaining)
Berkshire repurchased ~$4.5B of its own stock in Q2 2026 (~$4.8B in 1H 2026)
Thanksgiving 2025 gift: converted 1,800 A to 2.7M B shares; 1.5M to Susan Thompson Buffett Foundation, 400K each to Sherwood, Howard G. Buffett and NoVo foundations
